prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: hit while turning left. Injury: concussion. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1193; do not mention it.)
text:
Our firm represents [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was lawfully turning left at an intersection when your insured's vehicle struck the driver's side of our client's car. The impact was forceful enough to deploy airbags and cause significant damage to both vehicles. Our client was taken from the scene by ambulance and later diagnosed with a concussion, which has caused persistent headaches, dizziness, sensitivity to light, and difficulty concentrating. Our client has been unable to return to work for an extended period and continues to attend medical appointments and therapy sessions.

The available evidence points clearly to your insured as the party responsible for this collision. Your insured had a duty to yield to oncoming traffic before proceeding through the intersection and failed to do so. We have enclosed the medical records, imaging results, repair estimates, and wage documentation supporting our client's claim.

To resolve this matter without litigation, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT], which reflects medical expenses, lost income, future care needs, and general damages for pain and suffering. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without further notice.
